description: This file provides a data service module for a mechanic portal, handling local storage, and interactions with a Supabase backend for user authentication, request management, and profile handling.

methods.name: isSupabaseConfigured
methods.description: Checks if the necessary environment variables for Supabase are set.

methods.name: getMechanicStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the mechanic application status, either from Supabase or local mock data.

methods.name: registerMechanic
methods.description: Handles mechanic registration, creating user in Supabase or local mock, and setting profile data.

methods.name: createRequest
methods.description: Creates a new service request, either in Supabase or local storage.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user via Supabase or local mock data, and retrieves user info.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user from Supabase or clears local session.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Fetches current user info from Supabase or local storage.

methods.name: listUnassignedRequests
methods.description: Lists requests with no assigned mechanic, from Supabase or local mock.

methods.name: listMyAssignments
methods.description: Lists requests assigned to a mechanic, via Supabase join or local mock.

methods.name: getRequestById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific request by ID from Supabase or local storage.

methods.name: acceptRequest
methods.description: Assigns a request to a mechanic, updating status and notes, via Supabase or local mock.

methods.name: updateRequestStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a request, adding a note, via Supabase or local mock.

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.description: Updates user profile data in Supabase or local storage.
